_doc: PHASE 1 (OHLCV Truth Closure) PASS-B machine-readable output contract: OHLCV Truth -> Candle Mathematics handoff. DERIVED FROM EVIDENCE, NOT ASPIRATION: every guarantee binds an authoritative producer, a runtime enforcer (or 'none'), evidence refs, and a guarantee_status in {PROVEN, UNPROVEN, CONTRADICTED}. A guarantee is PROVEN only with executable/static/reproducible evidence AND an actual enforcer; repository convention, comments, filenames, and external API documentation are NARRATIVE and cannot prove. FAIL-CLOSED consumption rule: a consumer requiring the OHLCV handoff MUST reject any corpus that lacks an identity binding entry or relies on a non-PROVEN handoff-required guarantee. Because handoff-required guarantees are currently UNPROVEN/CONTRADICTED, the layer verdict is BLOCKED (see closure report).
authority: Governance/architecture only. Grants no economic claims, no remediation authority, no Phase-2 start.

guarantees.statement: Every consumed row carries the six mandatory fields (timestamp, open, high, low, close, volume); missing columns fail fast.

evidence.ref: backtest_v2.py:722-732
census 2026-07-10: 224/224 artifacts schema-classified; tests/data_ingestion/test_ohlcv_schema.py green

guarantees.statement: No NaN/inf values, no negative volume, no OHLC geometry violations reach a consumer; violations raise per row.

evidence.ref: ohlcv_schema.py:165-192
census: 0/224 files with nonfinite/negative-volume/OHLC violations

guarantees.statement: Timestamps parse against the canonical format set only; unparseable timestamps raise.

evidence.ref: ohlcv_schema.py:78-87

guarantees.statement: A logical corpus id (symbol+timeframe) resolves to exactly one physical artifact with a bound content hash; consumers cannot silently receive different bytes under the same name.
guarantees.authoritative_producer: none (no logical->physical resolver exists; consumers hard-code paths)

evidence.ref: census logical_rollup: 12/48 ambiguous, 9 same-logical-different-bytes
LIVE counterexample: HANDOFF.md:11 pins data/XAUUSD_M15.csv at sha 4d73f5ce..; on-disk bytes are 486cf361.. (spot-verified 2026-07-10) - the pinned bytes moved to data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv

guarantees.statement: The volume field carries one declared semantic per corpus, and consumers can discover it.

evidence.ref: five semantics measured: tick count (mt5_candle_fetcher.py:105), ccxt base volume, synthetic leg-volume/0 (fetch_forex_yfinance.py:130-157), Decimal child-sum (resample.py:93), latent price-range proxy (feature_pipeline.py:214-216)

guarantees.statement: Only COMPLETED bars are persisted/consumed; a forming (incomplete) bar can never enter a corpus.
guarantees.runtime_enforcer: none (future_ts_tolerance gates LABEL time only, dataset_integrity.py:353; a forming bar labeled in the past passes)

evidence.ref: temporal report T-SEM-4: no completed-bar check found in any fetcher

guarantees.statement: No undeclared substitution or repair: synthetic/substituted fields are declared to consumers; forbidden substitutions cannot occur silently.

evidence.ref: CONTRADICTED by construction: T-006 synthetic crosses carry no marker and reached the canonical root (census DUP-010/024/026/029); T-003 volume proxy renames nothing (feature_pipeline.py:214-216, latent, untested)

guarantees.statement: Session-aware gap policy (missing-candle thresholds, market calendar) is enforced before consumption.
guarantees.runtime_enforcer: ONLY backtest_v2 entry points (:2542/:2586) + fetch gates; ~45 other CandleLoader consumers stream without it (F-039)

handoff_gate_rule: Phase 1 may hand off to Candle Mathematics only when every handoff-required guarantee is PROVEN. Current: G-01..G-04 PROVEN; G-06/G-07/G-09 UNPROVEN; G-05/G-08/G-10 CONTRADICTED => BLOCKED.

mt5.volume_semantic: tick_count (mt5_candle_fetcher.py:105) - DECLARED here, unenforced in data
mt5.admissibility_note: Row-integrity + UTC proven; gated acquisition; consumers must carry the open-time caveat until G-06 is proven for this family.

yfinance.volume_semantic: SYNTHETIC for crosses (leg volume or 0, fetch_forex_yfinance.py:130-157); undeclared in data
yfinance.admissibility_note: BC-6: no verify gate, synthetic construction, tz unproven, forming-bar unproven. Usable only as explicitly-declared research scratch data.

data_root_fx.admissibility_note: Byte-identical to gated mt5 twins (census DUPs) EXCEPT XAUUSD_M15 - see BC-5: current root bytes were strict-gate quarantined and drifted from the HANDOFF pin; XAUUSD_M15 is NOT_ADMISSIBLE_AS_AUTHORITATIVE until its lineage is adjudicated.

data_root_crypto.volume_semantic: UNKNOWN (yfinance-descent for BTC/ETH/XRP/DOGE; indistinguishable for BNB/SOL)
data_root_crypto.timestamp_semantic: inherits yfinance UNPROVEN status for BTC/ETH/XRP/DOGE
data_root_crypto.admissibility_note: BC-3: descends from the ungated family. This classification does NOT declare binance/ authoritative - that is a remediation decision outside this contract.

resampled.volume_semantic: Decimal sum of parent volumes (semantic inherited from parent)
resampled.timestamp_semantic: open-time PROVEN (resample.py:95); tz inherited from parent
resampled.admissibility_note: Inherits every parent caveat (parents are data_root crypto majors => parent admissibility gates this family too).

archive_quarantine.admissibility_note: _archive_5wk/ frozen snapshots and _rejected/ quarantine. No active reader exists (proven); re-entry via byte-identical twins is the BC-5 channel.

htf_definitions.rolling_count_htf: HTFBuilder N-candle windows (boundaries drift after gaps) - backtest_v2.py:780-808
htf_definitions.rule: The two are DIFFERENT objects (CX-OHLCV-007). Any downstream doc/config saying 'H4' must say which.

forbidden_substitutions: synthetic volume presented without an is_synthetic declaration (T-003 proxy, T-006 leg-volume)
synthetic/derived OHLC presented as source data (T-006 cross construction)
forward/backward fill of candle rows (none exists in src/ today - preserved as a negative guarantee)
silent dedup policy changes (keep-first vs keep-last divergence, T-009 vs T-006)
alternate physical file consumed under a bound logical id without hash re-verification (FC-OHLCV-24)
timestamp shift or relabeling without provenance (FC-OHLCV-04/06)
replacing a hash-pinned canonical corpus without a recorded promotion decision (the BC-5 event)

trust_status.coverage_note: Mutation REGISTRATION is complete; DETECTION coverage is not. 8 classes (FC-OHLCV-04/05/06/08/19/20/21/24) have no current detector - they require the identity/semantics binding this contract specifies. '29/29 seeds' MUST NOT be read as E-MT-01 COMPLETE.
